## Description
**What**: Publish plugins/dso/docs/contracts/intent-coverage-findings.md with an embedded jsonschema (contract_version=1) defining the seven finding types and their severities, and implement plugins/dso/scripts/intent-coverage-check.sh implementing the (a) manifest-claim breadth check.
**Why**: This is the walking skeleton for the epic: it establishes the finding-record shape every consumer validates against, and the first check that produces the headline signal 'intent with no test'.
**Scope**:
- IN: intent-coverage-findings.md contract doc; the jsonschema artifact; the seven finding types (intent_with_no_test, test_artifact_missing_on_disk, test_artifact_fails, header_source_mismatch, dynamic_import_inconclusive, source_files_unresolved, file_impact_likely_stale) with severities; contract_version=1; intent-coverage-check.sh reading the 94ed manifest via intent-allocation-read.sh; per end-state intent_id steps (i) entry presence, (ii) realpath normalization then on-disk existence, (iii) test pass/fail; pre-commit-mode flag that runs only steps (i)+(ii); --output-file flag for ARG_MAX-safe findings output; exit codes 0/1/2.
- OUT: the header-vs-source check (sc-3); the consumers (sc-4); the e2e fixture suite (sc-5); per-language dynamic-import detection (sc-6).

## Done Definitions

- plugins/dso/docs/contracts/intent-coverage-findings.md is published and its embedded jsonschema validates against the JSON Schema draft-07 meta-schema ← Satisfies: sc-1
- The schema enumerates all seven finding types and carries contract_version=1; a findings document emitted by intent-coverage-check.sh validates against the schema ← Satisfies: sc-1
- intent-coverage-check.sh reads the 94ed manifest via intent-allocation-read.sh and, for an end-state intent_id whose test_artifact path is absent on disk, emits test_artifact_missing_on_disk; for an intent_id with no manifest entry it emits intent_with_no_test ← Satisfies: sc-2
- intent-coverage-check.sh in pre-commit mode runs only entry-presence and on-disk-existence checks (no test execution), writes findings via --output-file, and returns exit code 0 with no findings / 1 with warn-only findings / 2 with a block-mode finding ← Satisfies: sc-2
- When this story is complete, intent-coverage-check.sh in full (non-pre-commit) mode runs step (iii) test execution and, for an end-state intent_id whose registered test_artifact exists on disk but fails when run, emits the test_artifact_fails finding (block-mode) and returns exit code 2; the finding is suppressed when the manifest entry sets deferred_test:true ← Satisfies: sc-2
- Unit tests written and passing for all new or modified logic ← Satisfies: sc-2

## Considerations

- [Dependency] External blocker 94ed-f55c-51f5-45f6 (manifest schema): intent-coverage-check.sh reads the 94ed manifest via intent-allocation-read.sh; cross-epic dependency, not an in-epic story dependency.
- [Dependency] External blocker a03c-d55e-1393-4f27 (Closure Checks schema cleavage): findings reference end-state SC/DoD/AC items separated from Closure Checks by a03c's schema.
- [Build] intent-coverage-check.sh is a new .sh file and must have its executable bit set per CLAUDE.md.
- [Reliability] test_artifact.path resolution normalizes via realpath before the on-disk existence test to avoid symlink false negatives.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a DSO maintainer, I want a published findings contract and a manifest-claim breadth check, so that an end-state intent with no registered test is surfaced with a schema-validated finding.
